Transferable pattern: denominator = f(untrusted_value) where f applies unchecked fixed-width scaling before ''/'' or ''%'', while all checks validate f''s input instead of f''s output at division width. BRANCHES: branch1=hwmon-sysfs-scaled-divisor: sysfs/hwmon/thermal store handlers (fan RPM/pwm/target/limit attributes) where user input is multiplied, shifted, added, or subtracted in fixed width and then used as divisor in division/modulo during device programming - hunt for wrapped-zero or truncated-zero denominators; branch2=drm-userif-divisor: DRM/graphics driver user interfaces (sysfs, debugfs, ioctls for fan, clocks, power/OD settings across vendors/ASICs) where user-supplied numeric params are transformed into tach/divider/ratio values with unchecked arithmetic before a division; branch3=chardev-ioctl-divisor: non-DRM character-device ioctls (iio, media/DVB, HID, input, misc) accepting user numeric parameters (rates, periods, gains, timeouts, counts) that become divisors after unchecked fixed-width scaling or subtraction, including modulo-by-wrapped-zero; branch4=firmware-table-divisor: driver parsing of device/firmware-provided data (VBIOS/powerplay tables, ACPI, SMBIOS, EDID, DT properties, EEPROM) whose fields are used directly as divisors or scaled operands without range validation, reproducing the same zero/overflow-denominator from a non-user untrusted source.'
